CARD.NAME: Messages API
CARD.DESCRIPTION: Send WhatsApp messages through Work from n8n, Primata or any system, in the same format as Ticketz.

GTI_MESSAGES_API.TITLE: Message sending documentation
GTI_MESSAGES_API.SUBTITLE: Same format as the Ticketz API: on cutover, n8n and Primata only change the address.

INSTRUCTIONS.TITLE: Instructions
INSTRUCTIONS.TOKEN: Before sending messages, create a token below, tied to the connection that will send them.
INSTRUCTIONS.NUMBER: The number field accepts two kinds of value:
INSTRUCTIONS.NUMBER_PHONE: WhatsApp number: any number starting with the country code (Brazil = 55).
INSTRUCTIONS.NUMBER_JID: WhatsApp JID: the WhatsApp identifier; for groups it is a long number ending in {'@'}g.us.
INSTRUCTIONS.SAVE_ON_TICKET: saveOnTicket: false sends without leaving the conversation open in Tickets.

TOKENS.TITLE: Tokens per connection
TOKENS.DESCRIPTION: Each token sends through the chosen connection. Whoever holds a token can send messages as the company: keep it safe.
TOKENS.NAME: Name
TOKENS.REGENERATED: New token generated. Update the integrations that used the old one.
TOKENS.REGENERATE_CONFIRM: Click again to confirm: the current token stops working.
TOKENS.DELETE_CONFIRM: Click again to confirm the deletion.
